classification_rules.PASS: no reason code other than PASS

filter_rules: every entry of the UCSC ucscGenomes list is a candidate
excluded only if not active or the database id is not a plain identifier

reason_codes.ACCESSION_SHAPE: a refseq/genbank-labelled alias has a shape the generic validator does not know
reason_codes.ALIAS_COLLISION: one alias names several sequences, or equals another sequence's UCSC name
reason_codes.FETCH_ERROR: the source could not be fetched
reason_codes.MALFORMED_ROWS: rows are not alias<TAB>chrom<TAB>source with clean values
reason_codes.MULTIPLE_ALIAS_PER_AUTHORITY: several aliases for one sequence and authority (wide schema is lossy)
reason_codes.NEEDS_REVIEW: audit diagnostics and the production builder disagree
reason_codes.SOURCE_LABEL_MISMATCH: source label contradicts the accession's RefSeq/INSDC shape
reason_codes.UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_LABEL: a source label other than assembly/ensembl/genbank/refseq

audit.validations: current production builder rules (labels, RefSeq/INSDC shapes, alias uniqueness, one alias per sequence and authority), reimplemented independently for diagnosis and cross-checked against builder.build_registry
